title: introduce-econ-harvester-cli-and-quant-staging-curator
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We frequently get requests for tenant defaults that balance latency SLOs with unit cost. Existing heuristics are scattered across the runtime and the console; this PR centralizes a lightweight CLI-driven synthesis flow (econ-harvester) that produces tenant-level cost profiles and a companion quantization staging curator that proposes safe quant profiles for A/B rollout.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds a new CLI command `redwood econ-harvest` which ingests a short workload sample, telemetry hints, and tenant constraints and emits a recommended 'cost profile' (batching, cache, quant-stage) as JSON.
- Introduces services/economy/curator.py: runtime component that validates and stages quant profiles for safe rollouts (stage=shadow->canary->default).
- Adds minimal API surface: /api/internal/econ/profiles (POST) to accept samples and return recommendations. This endpoint is auth-protected and intended for Console/CLI use only.
- Adds telemetry metrics prefixed econ.harvester.* and a small audit log entry for every auto-suggestion.
- Console hook (backend only): a small migration enables Console to show a proposed profile; UI integration will be follow-up.

Backwards compatibility & safety: The curator only suggests profiles and writes to a staging table; it does not change live serving behavior unless an operator explicitly promotes a staged profile. Quant stages default to safe (float16 or q4f16 where supported) and we add a conservative fallback to the existing quant lookup so nothing in runtime degrades by default.

Config flags added: --sample-file, --target-cost-per-1000, --max-latency-ms, --dry-run, --emit-telemetry (default true). The CLI is alpha; feature gate via REDWOOD_ECON_HARVESTER=true.

Test plan: unit tests for the curator logic and CLI parsing are included (tests/test_econ_harvester.py). Added integration smoke test that runs the CLI against a small fixture and asserts JSON schema. CI initially failed on a flaky test (test_sampler) which was hardened.

Rollout plan: merge behind feature flag, enable for internal tenants for 48h, collect econ.harvester.* telemetry; then Console UI follow-up and gradual enable for SELT tenants.

Related work: references ENG-3245 (tenant defaults), ENG-4521 (quant staging safety). Links: Linear ENG-3245 (workstream), previous RFCs in docs/rfcs/econ-profiles.md.

Notes: This focuses on tooling and synthesis only. The follow-up will add a CLI command to promote staged profiles and a Console UI for preview+promote.
